scope: Internal native evidence for the Ebisumaru challenge HUD timer callback, seconds helpers, creator boundary, scheduler cadence, and root failure threshold. This record is not public page content.

proofs.scope: File42 HUD timer callback, setter/getter, creator observations, root's timer test and phase behavior, plus main scheduler/task pause ordering.

functions.name: func_080005DC_6F07EC
functions.abi: void(task pointer in a0, object pointer in a1); object argument unused by callback body
functions.observed: Reads signed word HUD+0x80, converts to seconds with signed divide by 30 and draws before decrementing the raw word by one; clamps a negative decrement result to zero. No phase/start/result gate exists in the callback. The normal task scheduler calls the task once per admitted update; main dispatch occurs before the camera loop.

functions.name: func_080008B8_6F0AC8
functions.observed: Stores seconds multiplied by 30 to HUD+0x80 without range validation. Normal root setup passes 99 seconds, yielding 2970 frames.

functions.name: func_080008CC_6F0ADC
functions.observed: Loads signed HUD+0x80, divides by 30 with signed integer division, returns whole seconds. Root tests this value against zero; with nonnegative remaining frames, 29 through 0 produce zero and enter timer failure, so native threshold is raw < 30.

functions.name: func_080008F4_6F0B04
functions.abi: Complete callable prototype not established; observed setup arguments include parent task pointer, X/Y words, and priority word.
functions.observed: Installs func_080005DC_6F07EC as the task callback and assigns bank 0x2A. No full call signature is published.

functions.name: func_08001954_6F1B64
functions.abi: void(task pointer in a0, object pointer in a1)
functions.observed: Root constructs HUD after phase-frame+0xDE exceeds 1, starts its timer at 99 seconds, calls the seconds getter, and enters the timer failure branch when the getter returns zero.

limitations: The proof reports that the Ghidra input executables are absent from the current shell host; no executable SHA256 is claimed.
Pause-mask skip logic is observed, but every pause reason is not decoded.
Static native analysis only; no game execution, live countdown timing, or multiplayer timer equality test was performed.
